import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../design/tokens/metrics.dart';
import '../../design/tokens/tokens.dart';

final Widget good = Builder(
  builder: (BuildContext context) {
    final TyTokens ty = context.ty;
    return Container(
      color: ty.colors.surface,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(TySpace.x8),
      child: SizedBox(
        width: TySize.trackLeading,
        child: Icon(
          Icons.close,
          color: Colors.transparent, // 允许：透明不是颜色选择。
          size: TyIconSize.normal,
        ),
      ),
    );
  },
);

final BoxBorder qrBorder = Border.all(
  color: Colors.white, // guard-ok: 二维码扫描要求纯白底，token 无法表达。
);
